description: DENSE: one vendor failing in four different areas at once. Every mandatory document is PRESENT, so the completeness gate passes and all four substantive reviewers run - the defects are in what the documents say, not in which ones are missing. This is the fixture shape the shallow set never had: a single agent must find four problems in one pass, while four specialists each have exactly one.

expected.note: The certificate names the right standard and looks entirely in order until the validity date is read. Valid until 2 November 2025, against a go-live of December 2026. The stem 'expire' rather than 'expired' deliberately - it also matches expires, expiry and expiration, and F05 established that form. A mustMention the model will not produce turns a caught defect into a scored miss, which is a measurement bug rather than a model failure.
Public liability is GBP 10m and passes; product liability is GBP 2m against a GBP 5m minimum. Reading only the first line clears this vendor.
The vendor CAN send an ASN, so a check for the capability passes. It arrives 2 hours before despatch against a required 4 - the gap is in the number, not the capability.
One open overdue major beside one closed minor. A count of non-conformances says two; what matters is that one of them is open, major and past its due date.
